bullets.text: Three consecutive months of mid-teens premium growth; Direct personal lines matched mid-teens; Commercial Lines grew 20%+; Agency returned to growth around 6%; Property was fully additive for the final quarter.
Direct produced higher aggregate CRs during rapid growth; March CR increased 7.6 pts YOY primarily from weather and hail; company remains committed to its aggregate calendar 96 CR goal.
Reached milestones of just over 10M auto PIF covering ~16.5M vehicles, and north of 15M total companywide policies across special lines, commercial lines, and property.

Average written premium increased ~4% to match aggregate trend; strategy relies on taking continuous small rate increases state by state to match expected auto trends while preserving customer retention and brand appeal.

Early hail hurt Property results, and weather losses drove most March variance. Rather than normalizing results with seasonal premium adjustments, catastrophe loads are spread over policy periods, accepting monthly volatility.

Announced pilot program with Uber in Texas, designing collaborative insurance coverage across driver operational phases; company is assuming limited indemnity risk initially while gathering data for future pricing.

Enthusiasm for Destination Era strategy remains unaffected by early hail. Terminating a producer relationship slowed ASI net growth, but integration after one year allows focus on external market opportunities.

Portfolio produced a fully taxable equivalent total return of 1.2% amidst notable equity market volatility; management emphasizes long-held operational discipline over pursuing higher returns at unacceptable risk levels.

Platinum offering in Agency raised brand profile; Commercial Lines benefited from fewer competitors bidding; Snapshot redesign and newest product models continue state expansion, alongside increasing overall brand strength.

Amid profitable growth challenges, claims and customer relationship groups hire and train ahead of need to maintain service quality. Catastrophe response adds a momentary challenge where Progressive aims to outperform.
